items.difficulty_reason: The lemma states the compatibility of the Gysin type boundary map of the log complex with the maps attached to the first Chern class of the divisor, as the commutativity of a square in the derived category (statement lines 2559-2590). The proof identifies both maps with boundaries of punctured line bundle sequences and, by functoriality, reduces the claim to exhibiting two morphisms of short exact sequences; the middle arrows are given by explicit formulas replacing the logarithmic derivative of a local generator by that of a defining equation of the divisor, the constructions of the two lemmas matching. The explicit comparison morphisms are the substance, so the claim is H2.
